entry.title: Australia: Cash rate target, 5 November 2026
entry.summary: Australia, Cash rate target: Veritane switched to a different source dataset (F1 FIRMMCRTD) on 7 November 2026. Figures before that date come from the earlier dataset. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia, F1 FIRMMCRTD.
